note: Product targets only; each must expect clean. Deliberate-leak controls are built into tools/canary.py and always run. A target runs with PATH, a scratch HOME and TMPDIR, the CANARY_* variables, and the parent's value of each variable it names under env (names only, from tools/canary.py TARGET_ENV_ALLOWED). Owner names: each target's plain name is in broker/loops/plainname.go (loops S41), never here; a target without one fails TestThePlainNameMapCoversEveryLoop7Subject. Containment: contain is optional. A leak from a target without contain pauses nothing by itself, but a canary finding always offers STOP (loops S38), so the owner reads: "My leak self-test found a planted test secret in <plain name>. Reply STOP to pause everything."
